name: nonApi_recordInviteEmailed
description: Stamps HC.Hasher.InviteEmailedAt = now for the hashers an 'Email invite codes' send reached (E2.F2.S6), so the next send skips anyone invited in the last 7 days. Called by the InviteEmails API endpoint after the emails are handed to ACS — internal, no device auth. Never touches updatedAt (the Hasher triggers fire only on updatedAt / name / photo / removed), so nothing re-syncs. One LOG.GeneralLog row per send (LogSource 'InviteEmail', StrParam1 = kennel id, Data = {admin, sent}). An empty or NULL list is a successful no-op with stamped = 0. Ids that do not parse as GUIDs are dropped silently by TRY_CAST.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel the invites were for; logged only (LOG.GeneralLog.StrParam1, HC.ErrorLog.kennelId). Default NULL.

parameters.name: adminId
parameters.description: The admin who sent them; logged only. Default NULL.

parameters.name: hasherIds
parameters.description: '|'-separated HC.Hasher ids that were sent to. NULL or '' ⇒ no-op. Default NULL.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always exactly one row: { Success, ErrorMessage, stamped }, from the TRY (Success 1) or the CATCH (Success 0, stamped 0).

columns.name: Success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 when the CATCH block ran.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block on failure.

columns.name: stamped
columns.description: Rows of HC.Hasher whose InviteEmailedAt was set (0 on a no-op or on failure).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET InviteEmailedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() for every id in the list, inside a transaction with the log insert. updatedAt is not stamped; trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForHasher does not fire for this column.
On any runtime error: rolls back, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<api>', userId = @adminId, kennelId = @kennelId), returns the envelope with Success 0.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
